## What's Changed
* ci: split frontend and Rust PR checks by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/475
* fix: remove dim-chrome-while-typing from external editor by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/476
* Add Polish translation (#477) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/477
* Add keep running on last window close setting (#478)[Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/478
* Icons: 1.5 stroke width, DEV badge, separate dev build config (#479) [Release] by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/479

* Consolidate settings definitions (#485) by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/488
* Centralize Space change commits and renderer apply by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/490

* Treat version suffixes as note names, not file extensions by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/493
* Add weekly, monthly, and quarterly notes by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/499
* Fix raw editor caret positioning and selection layering by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/500
* Fix tab close button positioning by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/501
* Refactor settings into categorized editor and experimental tabs by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/502
* Fix pending app menu commands by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/503
* Refine editor mode switch and toolbar labels by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/504
* Improve settings usage charts and space insights by @SidhuK in https://github.com/SidhuK/Glyph/pull/505
